finite_order_criterion: For positive coefficients, degree n, and integer d>=n, normalized log concavity at 1<=j<n is equivalent to (d-j)A_j>=R_j, with A_j=j*a_j^2-(j+1)*a_(j-1)*a_(j+1) and R_j=(j+1)*a_(j-1)*a_(j+1)>0. A finite order exists iff every A_j>0; the least order is max(n,max_j(j+ceil(R_j/A_j))).
coefficient_signs: F_r has positive coefficients on degrees 0 through r-2; B_s has positive coefficients on degrees 0 through s. Their products have positive coefficients at every degree in the interval.
scope_limit: Exact finite arithmetic for 2<=r,s<=20 and 1<=q<=4. No uniform, mixed-factor, graph, selector, or tree implication was reviewed or established.
